lines: As that reflected thing shines, so shines
the world in the Supreme Lord's light.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yathā etat pratibimbitaṃ bhāti tathaiva viśvaṃ parameśvaraprakāśe

reads_against.argmap: What does the pratibimba claim extend to? → The mirror-model scales: viśva is pratibimba of parameśvara-prakāśa, nothing self-luminous below the Lord.
c1_essence: The world shines as reflection in the Supreme Lord's light, no self-luminosity below him.
